GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-12-30T13:55:37Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: ALL JOIN inflating numbers
Description: Hi there,
imagine a simple query with a join like the following. When using an ANY join I get the same result as without a join but as soon as I use ALL, the result from the local fields (impressions, value..) is inflated. Usually this inflation is just 1-4% but in some cases it is 10-100 times. What would be the best course of action here?

```
SELECT
    category,
    count() AS impressions,
    uniq(sessionId) as sessions,
    sum(value) as value,
    sum(visible) AS visible,
    sum(engaged) AS engaged
FROM impressions ALL LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        CounterID,
        engaged,
        visible
    FROM visits
    GROUP BY CounterID
) USING CounterID
GROUP BY category
```

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]

1. ALL JOIN in ClickHouse duplicates rows when there are multiple matches
2. This causes the aggregation functions (count(), sum(), etc.) to count values multiple times
3. The solution would involve either using ANY JOIN (as the user noted works correctly) or restructuring the query
